archetypes.name: step0-flow
archetypes.rationale: The change moves a Step 0 control-flow gate between wrappers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design Step 0 session, route, and init handoff after the degraded gate fold. Focus on whether stdout KVs still support the prompt-side branches and whether deleted wrapper references are fully retired Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: gate-envelope
archetypes.rationale: The session wrapper now parses and re-emits degraded-tools gate state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the degraded-tools gate parsing in design-step0-session.sh. Verify that DEGRADED, BOTH_DOWN, prompt-required status, non-interactive behavior, and execution-issues logging match the prior wrapper contract Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
